title: Fall of the USSR
summary: In a single astonishing year the Soviet Union unraveled — from reform to coup to dissolution.

stories.summary: Five moments that ended the Soviet experiment.

events.title: Perestroika Announced
events.body: Mikhail Gorbachev became General Secretary and launched perestroika and glasnost — restructuring and openness meant to revive a stagnant system but which ultimately loosened its foundations.

events.title: Baltic Independence
events.body: Lithuania declared restoration of independence, followed by Latvia and Estonia. Moscow's attempts to suppress the Baltic republics failed and emboldened separatists across the union.

events.title: The August Coup
events.body: Hardline Communists detained Gorbachev at his Crimean dacha and declared a state of emergency. Boris Yeltsin rallied resistance at the White House and the coup collapsed in three days.

events.title: Belavezha Accords
events.body: Leaders of Russia, Ukraine, and Belarus met in a Belarusian hunting lodge and declared the Soviet Union dissolved, replacing it with the Commonwealth of Independent States.

events.title: Dissolution
events.body: The Supreme Soviet voted itself out of existence. Gorbachev resigned and the hammer and sickle came down from the Kremlin — the Cold War was over.
